items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, unrestricted file upload, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary Code Execution via Webhooks
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in the webhooks component allows unauthenticated, zero-interaction arbitrary code execution, rated with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, with a CVSS score of 9.6, allows attackers to plant malicious files on the server due to unrestricted file upload.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extension leading to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that lets unauthenticated attackers upload executable files to any store using a polyglot to bypass validation.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and gain unauthorized access to store data.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Multiple Vulnerabilities
items.summary: This vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce versions and is rated as high severity with a CVSS score of 8.7.
